entries.description: apache2 and nginx no longer stay down after a reboot on a static IPv6 address that is still tentative (duplicate address detection) when they start, as with ifupdown on Debian; the kernel lets them bind it, and one the race already took down is started again
Sieve belongs to the mail block: a mail box without it gets it, delivery goes through LMTP, and its exim autoreplies become Sieve vacation rules that the webmail can edit too
h-delete-sys-sieve is gone: Sieve belongs to the mail block and is no longer removed on its own
